items.exampleEn: The factory ceased production after fifty years.
items.exampleZh: 那家工廠在五十年後停止生產。

items.exampleEn: The oldest son will inherit the family business one day.
items.exampleZh: 長子將來會繼承家族事業。

items.exampleEn: The illustration on page ten shows a map of the old city.
items.exampleZh: 第十頁的插圖是一張老城區的地圖。

items.exampleEn: The long strike weakened the company.
items.exampleZh: 長時間的罷工削弱了那家公司。

items.exampleEn: Let's skip the boring part and go straight to the questions.
items.exampleZh: 我們跳過無聊的部分，直接進入問答吧。

items.exampleEn: She dipped her toes into the cold lake.
items.exampleZh: 她把腳趾伸進冰冷的湖水裡泡了一下。

items.exampleEn: The kids sneaked into the kitchen to take some cookies.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們偷偷溜進廚房拿了一些餅乾。

items.exampleEn: We keep a spare key at my aunt's house.
items.exampleZh: 我們在阿姨家放了一把備用鑰匙。
items.glossZh: 備用的；多餘的；抽出（時間）

items.sentenceEn: Can you spare a few minutes to look at my report?
items.sentenceZh: 你可以抽出幾分鐘看一下我的報告嗎？

items.audioEn: The heavy rain finally ceased at noon, so the match started an hour late.
items.audioZh: 大雨終於在中午停了，所以比賽晚了一個小時開始。
options: It started an hour earlier than planned

items.sentenceEn: She inherited her mother's love of music.
items.sentenceZh: 她遺傳了母親對音樂的熱愛。

items.sentenceEn: Our cat sneaks onto the sofa whenever we leave the room.
items.sentenceZh: 每次我們離開房間，我們家的貓就偷偷溜上沙發。

items.stemEn: ____ the strawberries in melted chocolate before serving them.
items.stemZh: 上桌前，把草莓蘸一下融化的巧克力。

items.stemEn: I was so busy that I had to ____ lunch and eat a sandwich at my desk later.
items.stemZh: 我忙到只好不吃午餐，晚點才在辦公桌前吃三明治。

items.passageEn: My aunt is an artist who draws illustrations for children's books. She says her grandmother, who painted flowers in her spare time, first taught her to draw. For each picture, she makes a quick sketch before she adds color. Last year, she almost ceased working because her eyes had weakened, but a pair of special glasses solved the problem. Now she works every morning in a small room full of paper and paint. When I visit, she lets me sneak a look at her next book.
items.passageZh: 我阿姨是一位替童書畫插圖的畫家。她說是她的祖母先教她畫畫的，祖母平常有空會畫花。每一幅畫，她都先畫一張速寫，再上色。去年她的視力變差，差點停止工作，不過一副特製眼鏡解決了問題。現在她每天早上都在一間堆滿紙和顏料的小房間裡工作。我去拜訪時，她會讓我偷看一下她的下一本書。

questions.questionZh: 阿姨去年為什麼差點停止工作？
阿姨畫每一幅畫時，第一步做什麼？

items.promptZh: 暴風雨移到陸地上之後就減弱了。
referenceEn: The storm weakened after it moved over land.
After the storm moved over land, it weakened.
rubricZh: 要用 weaken 當不及物動詞（例如 the storm weakened）
「移到陸地上」可寫，例如 moved over land、reached land 等
時態配合內容（例如 weakened、weakens 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 spare 造一個句子，說說你空閒時做什麼，或你會準備哪些備用的東西。
referenceEn: In my spare time, I like to go cycling by the river.
I always carry a spare pair of socks in my sports bag.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 spare（例如 spare time、a spare pair of socks）
spare 也可當動詞，例如 spare some time 等
